sources.g1:
(a) =>
  let x = if a is Int then 1 else "s"
  if a is Int then x + 1 else x ++ "!"
sources.g4:
(a, b) =>
  if a is
    Int then (if b is Int then a + b else a)
    else (if b is Str then b else "none")
sources.g10: (a) => if (a as Int | Str) is Int then 1 else 2
sources.g11: (a) => if pick(a) is Int then a + 1 else a ++ "!"
sources.f6: (a) => if a is Int then (if a is Str then a as Bool else a) else a
sources.tbad: (x, b) => if x is Int then b + 1 else 0
sources.tsel: (a, b) => if a is Int then (if b is Int then 1 else (a as Str)) else 1
